samen te zullen drijven

examples.text: De herdershond dreef de kudde in een oogwenk samen.
The city hall needs to round up all the wrongly parked bikes across the city.
They rounded up a group of experts and got their opinions.

glosses: To gather (livestock such as cattle, sheep, geese, etc.) together, such as by encircling them.

examples.text: In the autumn we round up all the hill sheep and bring them down into the barn.

glosses: To arrest or detain a group of people based on collective (rather than individualized) cause or suspicion, often as a form of targeted persecution.

examples.text: During the Holocaust, the Nazis rounded up Jews into ghettos and concentration camps.
Major Strasser has been shot. Round up the usual suspects.

glosses: To round (a number) to the smallest integer that is not less than it, or to some other greater value, especially a whole number of hundreds, thousands, etc.

examples.text: The total is $24,995 — let's round it up to $25,000.
